authority: User requested arithmetic bid/ask midpoint for both buys and sells, V7 12.5% option premium stop, and ITM expiry exit 15 minutes before the option regular close.
fill_and_mark_basis: Always (bid+ask)/2 from a valid fresh quote. Supplied midpoint and last are reference fields only.
stop_basis: Current long option midpoint <= entry midpoint * 0.875. Fixed per purchased leg, calls and puts alike; costs excluded from trigger.
strategy_exit: Underlying strategy sell signal retained. Generic underlying 5% stop disabled.
risk_sale: Use the validated stop or ITM-expiry trigger quote midpoint at the observation clock; retain original SIP timestamp separately. No second quote or broker fill proof.
observation: Minute observations and fresh quotes; a gap records missingness and the next valid observation may exit beyond the threshold.
expiry: For still-open ITM positions, exit 15 minutes before the dated option-class regular close, including early closes. Require a fresh causal Alpaca stock mark to classify ITM.
other_expiry: Existing OTM roll and unresolved physical-expiry policies remain; no inferred intrinsic-value sale.
costs: Fee 0.10% plus slippage allowance 0.05% per side, separate from midpoint stop calculation.
artifact_scope: Preserve unchanged raw stock/options/reference inputs and their immutable predecessor manifest. Rebuild strategy proposals, option paths, marks, labels and portfolios under the new source/policy binding.
